column1: # Golden fit set (#2635): reference models fitted nightly on Linux by
# .github/workflows/golden-fits.yml and diffed against the last release.
# One row per estimator / structural / endpoint family. The point is coverage of
# *families*, not of features: each row is the cheapest committed example that puts
# its family on the fit path. Feature-specific pins stay with the NONMEM anchors
# (nonmem_anchor/) and the Tier-3 convergence bands; this set does not replace them.
#   id      stable key in results.json and bands.json — never reuse one for a different
#           model; retire it and add a new id instead, so its history stays its own
#   model   repo-relative .ferx path (read from the tree being fitted, so a release
#           baseline uses the release's copy of the file)
#   family  what the row is in the set for; tests/golden_fit_set.rs requires distinct
# Not covered: GN / GN-hybrid / Laplace / AGQ / Bayes / VI — no examples/ model uses
# them today. Add a row when one does, rather than a golden-only model file.

column4: combined error, correlated residuals (evaluation only, maxiter = 0)
